sloka: कृच्छ्रेण तु समाश्वस्य सङ्गम्य च ततस्ततः।वृक्षाद्रिहस्ता हरयः सम्प्रतस्थू रणाजिरम् ।। ६.६६.८ ।।
transliteration: kṛcchreṇa tu samāśvasya saṅgamya ca tatastataḥ।vṛkṣādrihastā harayaḥ sampratasthū raṇājiram ।। 6.66.8 ।।

translations.english: Overcoming fear, the Vanaras getting together from here and there holding trees by hand, proceeded to the battlefield.
